# grafana-adaptive-logs_recommendations (Data Source)

Retrieves Adaptive Logs' system-generated pattern recommendations: detected log patterns with a suggested tenant-wide and per-segment drop rate. Read-only; regenerated asynchronously roughly every 24 hours.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "grafana-adaptive-logs_recommendations" "all" {}

output "top_drop_candidates" {
  value = [
    for r in data.grafana-adaptive-logs_recommendations.all.recommendations :
    r.tokens if r.recommended_drop_rate > 50
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `recommendations` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--recommendations))

<a id="nestedatt--recommendations"></a>
### Nested Schema for `recommendations`

Read-Only:

- `configured_drop_rate` (Number) The drop rate currently configured for this pattern, if any.
- `ingested_lines` (Number) Total log lines ingested for this pattern.
- `levels` (List of String) Log levels observed for this pattern.
- `locked` (Boolean) Whether this recommendation is locked against automatic changes.
- `queried_lines` (Number) Total log lines queried for this pattern.
- `recommended_drop_rate` (Number) Recommended tenant-wide drop rate (0-100) for this pattern.
- `segments` (Attributes Map) Per-segment breakdown, keyed by the segment's LogQL selector. A non-empty entry here is the read-only signal for where a "segment override" drop rule would apply. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--recommendations--segments))
- `superseded` (Boolean) Whether this recommendation has been superseded by a newer one.
- `tokens` (List of String) The tokenized log pattern this recommendation was detected for.
- `volume` (Number) Total bytes ingested for this pattern.

<a id="nestedatt--recommendations--segments"></a>
### Nested Schema for `recommendations.segments`

Read-Only:

- `ingested_lines` (Number) Log lines ingested for this pattern within this segment.
- `locked` (Boolean) Whether this segment's recommendation is locked against automatic changes.
- `queried_lines` (Number) Log lines queried for this pattern within this segment.
- `recommended_drop_rate` (Number) Recommended drop rate (0-100) for this pattern within this segment - the basis for a "segment override" drop rule.
- `volume` (Number) Bytes ingested for this pattern within this segment.
